children: , the pharmaceutical and vaccines company, won an FDA label update adding HYPERION trial data for adults recently diagnosed with pulmonary arterial hypertension. Shares rose about 1.0% to $149.56 at 11.19am ET Time on Thursday.

In the 320-person trial, Winrevair plus background therapy cut the risk of clinical worsening by 76% versus placebo. First events occurred in 10.6% of treated patients, compared with 36.9% of those receiving placebo.

The chart puts Merck's share price at $149.56, 23.8% above GuruFocus' $120.80 GF Value estimatea reminder that the market already prices in substantial expectations. The broader label could support earlier use, but commercial gains still hinge on diagnosis, insurance coverage and how long patients stay on treatment.

title: Merck Jumps as Winrevair Moves Earlier in PAH
